root_cause: Command Hub Autopilot 'Runs' tab called GET /api/v1/automations/runs (tenant-scoped consumer automation engine) instead of GET /api/v1/dev-autopilot/runs (dev_autopilot_runs scan-run history, the subsystem every sibling Autopilot tab already reads from). The consumer route 400s 'tenant_id required' for any Command Hub call because getTenantId() never reads the X-Vitana-Tenant header the Command Hub sends.
fix: Repointed fetchAutopilotRuns() at /api/v1/dev-autopilot/runs and rewrote renderAutopilotRunsView()/autopilotStatusColor() to the real dev_autopilot_runs row shape and status enum (running|ingesting|ranking|planning|done|failed).

test_results.mutation_check: reverting the endpoint string to /api/v1/automations/runs fails exactly 1 assertion in the new suite, confirming the test is load-bearing

not_done: An operator executor run (agent 7f837403 / VTID-04256) had been queued for this same fix and exhausted its 120-turn cap without committing a change; this VTID supersedes that attempt with a direct, verified fix. The underlying reason the agent burned its turn budget purely on search/read tool calls (search_text/read_file/find_files) without ever reaching a write_file/edit_file call is a separate, unaddressed defect in the agent executor and is not fixed by this VTID.
